title: Geometric reducedness descends along schematic dominance
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], W and X schemes, h:W→X a quasi-compact morphism (inverse images of affine open subsets are quasi-compact), and p:X→Spec k [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Suppose h is scheme-theoretically dominant [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image], meaning that the kernel of the map O_X→h_*O_W is zero. If the composite h;p is geometrically reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], then p is geometrically reduced: every field base change of X over k is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. No affineness, nonemptiness, or finite-type assumption on W or X is required.

source.place: Tags 081I (lemma-flat-base-change-scheme-theoretic-image) and 056B (lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced), applied after each field extension

proof.text: Apply geometrically_iff_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms to test the reducedness of X×_k Spec K for each field K and map y:Spec K→Spec k. Its projection a to X is flat, since every morphism between spectra of fields is flat and flatness is stable under base change. In Lean, Flat a is inferred directly.

Use pullbackRightPullbackFstIso p y h to identify W×_X(X×_k Spec K) with W×_k Spec K. The latter is reduced by the geometric reducedness hypothesis on h;p. Transport reducedness along this isomorphism using isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion.

The Mathlib instance IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.pullbackSnd makes the pullback of h along flat a scheme-theoretically dominant; quasi-compactness is also stable under base change. Apply IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.isReduced to this morphism to deduce reducedness of X×_k Spec K. This closes the geometric reducedness criterion. The argument never chooses a point, so also treats empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Tags 081I and 056B; the existing fully proved public helper is moved unchanged from the retired Sheaf radicial module. Each Lean step uses only Mathlib.

theorem geometricallyReduced_of_schemeTheoreticallyDominant
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {W X : Scheme.{u}}
    (h : W ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant h] [QuasiCompact h]
    (hred : GeometricallyReduced (h ≫ p)) : GeometricallyReduced p
